scenes.vo: Why are you taller in the morning?
Your spine has soft discs between bones.
All day, gravity gently squeezes them thinner.
During sleep, discs rehydrate and rebound slightly.
Measure after waking for your baseline.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
